records.title: DEVELOPMENT OF DRONE CORRIDORS IN ODISHA
details:
Three more airstrips, Rangeilunda, Amarda, and Rairangpur (Dandabose) have
been identified for development to support future RCS operations.
Development work at the Rangeilunda airstrip is currently being carried out by the
State Government under the UDAN scheme and is expected to be completed by
March 31, 2026.

details: A Scheme for viability gap funding for Battery Energy Storage Systems (BEEs) and Pump Storage Projects (PSP) is under consideration by the Government.

records.title: Status of Developing 4000 Modernized Anganwadi centres
details: Construction of these AWC buildings is awaiting completion. However, the MOU with Vedanta Ltd., has lapsed after extension.

records.title: Status of draft National e-Commerce Policy
details: A draft of National e-Commerce policy has been prepared after detailed public consultations. Valuable suggestions have been received from many stakeholders. Inter-ministerial consultations are being held to finalise the National e-Commerce Policy.

records.title: Regulation of non-personal data
details: The Personal Data Protection Bill, 2019 is under consideration of Joint Committee of Parliament.

records.title: Finalization of the Draft Intermediary Guidelines Rules, 2018
details: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology is finalising draft Intermediaries Guidelines Rules.

records.title: Future plans for floating solar projects
details: Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited (SECI) has received in-principle approval from the Government of Odisha for setting up of 40 MW floating solar projects at Chiplima power channel pond. A proposal for setting up another 500 MW floating solar projects at Hirakud reservoir has also been submitted by SECI to Government of Odisha

records.title: Status of stolen antiquities from Odisha
Status of stolen antiquities from Odisha
details: Hon'ble Minister inter-alia stated as under:- Mr. Chairman, Sir, it is already being worked out. I will also inform the hon. Member. The work is in progress on this front. We are already working on the amendments to this Act. Hon. Chairman, Sir, this is under the National Mission for tabulating all these Acts and artifacts. The work is in progress. The work is being undertaken and that is how the antiquities have already been listed. Hon. Member is right that we have more than three lakh – close to four lakhs – pieces and have been documented in a particular State and, over all, there are eight lakhs and above. So far as data management and block chain technology, etc., is concerned, this work is also being undertaken. On other aspects, I would like to submit that we are in touch with IIT, Delhi, and this project is being worked at.
